subject: Request: onboarding grace + sandbox top-up for Fintego integration
messages:
From: Oliver Chen <oliver@fintego.com>
To: Elliot Price <elliot@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Singh <priya@fintego.com>
Date: 2028-06-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Onboarding stalled — request for sandbox top-up and grace period

Hi Elliot,

Quick note from our engineering team: we hit a blocker during SSO verification with Redwood in our staging environment. The cert chain between our IdP and Redwood's SAML handler is failing during the redirect exchange — engineers are deep in investigation but expect this to take 7–10 working days to fully resolve.

This puts our demo and evaluation window at risk. Given the delay, can Redwood provide:
- a 30-day extension on our pilot window, and
- a sandbox top-up (~200k tokens) so we can continue internal testing and end-to-end checks once the SSO fix is applied

I attached a screenshot of the error and a short build log. We appreciate any runway you can provide — happy to join a call with your team to walk through the trace.

Thanks,
Oliver
Oliver Chen
Director of Integrations, Fintego
oliver@fintego.com

Attachments: sso-error-snapshot.png (image), build-log.txt (text)
From: Elliot Price <elliot@redwood.com>
To: Oliver Chen <oliver@fintego.com>
Cc: Priya Singh <priya@fintego.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-06-18T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding stalled — request for sandbox top-up and grace period

Hi Oliver — thanks for the heads up and for sending the logs. I'm sorry to hear the SSO handshake is blocking progress.

I'm looping in Marissa (CS) and Ben (Solutions Eng) so we can triage quickly. Preliminary plan from my side:
- We can temporarily approve a 30-day pilot extension now (pending engineering follow-up).
- For sandbox credits, I can propose an interim top-up of 150k tokens while we validate the root cause; if we confirm it's on our side we'll make good on an additional adjustment.

Marissa/Ben — can you confirm availability for a 60–90 minute triage session? Oliver, would Monday or Tuesday morning PST work for your engineers?

Elliot Price
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
elliot@redwood.com | (415) 555-0126

--
Forwarded attachment: build-log.txt
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Elliot Price <elliot@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Oliver Chen <oliver@fintego.com>
Date: 2028-06-19T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding stalled — request for sandbox top-up and grace period

On Tue, Jun 18, 2028 at 09:12 AM Oliver Chen <oliver@fintego.com> wrote:
> Quick note from our engineering team: we hit a blocker during SSO verification with Redwood in our staging environment. ...

Thanks for the detail, Oliver. Quick triage notes from our infra team after a first-pass: the symptom looks like an incomplete cert chain returned by the IdP during the SAML response — that can present as a redirect/validation failure depending on how the SP (our side) is configured.

To move fast:
- Can you share the full SAML response with the x509 cert header (we can accept a redacted copy) and the timestamped request IDs?
- If you can provide that prior to the call, we can skip a lot of back-and-forth.

Credit/extension suggestion: we can provision 100k tokens immediately as a safety-net so your QA team can continue smoke tests that don't require full SSO. After the triage call and a quick verification, we will re-evaluate and uplift to 150k if it's clear the blocker wasn't caused by Fintego devs.

Attached a short runbook for SSO checks that should help your engineers gather the right artifacts.

Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Attachments: runbook-SSO-check.pdf
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Elliot Price <elliot@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Oliver Chen <oliver@fintego.com>
Date: 2028-06-19T12:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding stalled — request for sandbox top-up and grace period

Thanks team — I've reviewed and discussed with my manager. Approvals:
- 30-day pilot extension: APPROVED
- Sandbox top-up: APPROVED at 150,000 tokens now; discretionary uplift to 200,000 pending triage outcome and engineering notes

Next steps (internal): I'll open a promotional credit record with Finance (approval link below) so this is tracked against FIN-2028-044. Marissa — please confirm once you have the SAML response and we'll push the top-up.

Approval record: https://redwood.internal/approvals/FIN-2028-044

Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com
From: Oliver Chen <oliver@fintego.com>
To: Elliot Price <elliot@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-06-20T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding stalled — request for sandbox top-up and grace period

Thanks, Elliot / Marissa / Ben — this is great news and much appreciated. We'll extract the SAML response/redacted cert headers and upload them to the secure share before the triage call. Monday 10:00 AM PST works for our engineers.

I'll confirm the calendar invite and include a short agenda (trace, logs, quick fixes, timeline estimate).

Appreciate the quick turnaround — talk Monday.

Oliver
